why: ci-126 with one knob moved: the recorded agent and the baseline are stun-first instead of search-4. Seeds 1, 5001 and 10001 at 5000 matches, lambda 0.9, the ADR 0048 baseline, explore 0.2, alpha 10, min samples 10, share action, baseline alpha 10000, and the clone control again, so every row reads against ci-126 on the same data with only the teacher different. The question the ci-126 entry left: a clone is capped at its teacher, exactly and tightly (0.4950 to 0.5000 against search-4 across three seeds, copying 99.3 % of its decisions), so the only lever the clone arm has left is whom it copies, and stun-first is the strongest agent this project has measured -- every match from Greedy and Random, 0.97 against search-4, 0.80 against pressure-floor, on seeds nothing had played (journal, 2026-09-17). An expectation written before the run: the copy accuracy should hold at or above ci-126's 99.3 %, since stun-first plays a narrower repertoire than search-4 (mirror entropy 2.65 against Greedy's 3.12, and four spells carry its play against Greedy), and the clone should land at parity with it. If both happen, the clone is by a distance the strongest policy trained here and the first in months that should clear the champion bar against ci-69; this run does not commit it, and a dispatch with commit=true is what proposes it. The refutation: ci-116 found a stronger teacher copied worse, 92.3 % on mixture-mean against 96.3 % on search-4, because a wider repertoire is harder to copy -- if the accuracy falls here instead of holding, the cap is the repertoire rather than what the model can see, and the terms did not remove it after all. Two further readings to write down first, because they are likely and would otherwise look like surprises. The value fit should be worse than ci-126's, not better: it learns from returns, and stun-first's mirror is decided by who moves first 92.5 % of the time, so the returns of its self-play carry that rather than what an action did. And the clone's win rate against Greedy should be near one where ci-126 read 0.72 to 0.87, since it is copying an agent that takes every match; a clone near parity with its teacher against a teacher this strong is not comparable with any earlier clone row, only with its own teacher.
